title: Conveyor sensor fault
description: A proximity sensor on packaging line 3 stopped registering box positions after a firmware update, causing two boxes to collide at the merge point. Maintenance logs show the sensor's debounce interval was reset to a default value during the update.

title: Battery pack overheating
description: A handheld scanner's battery pack reached 61°C during a routine 8-hour shift, triggering an automatic shutdown. Investigation found a swollen cell in the pack, consistent with a manufacturing defect in that production batch.
